caption: The drawing depicts a single object, a ceramic pitcher or jug, positioned centrally on a plain, light beige background. The jug is medium-sized with a rotund, ribbed body and a slightly narrower base. It has a rounded handle attached to one side and a small, rounded pouring spout on the opposite side. The color of the jug is a rich reddish-brown with highlights and shadows indicating a reflective, glazed surface. The overall composition is simple, with the jug occupying the middle of the image and no other objects or decorative elements present.
title: Small Pitcher
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
